This approval represents the first regulatory validation of a PROTAC-based approach for targeted breast cancer treatment in patients with ESR1 mutations. The development of vepdegestrant demonstrates the therapeutic potential of PROTACs as an emerging drug class for hormone receptor-driven cancers.
